name: Single-Arm Dumbbell Preacher Curl
summary: An isolated bicep curl performed one arm at a time against a preacher bench pad to minimize shoulder involvement and enforce strict elbow flexion.

setup: Adjust the preacher bench seat height so your armpit rests comfortably near the top of the angled pad.
Grasp a dumbbell with one hand in an underhand (supinated) grip.
Rest the back of your upper arm flush against the pad, extending your arm downward while bracing your non-working arm or body on the frame.
steps: Inhale and curl the dumbbell upward by flexing your elbow while keeping your upper arm firmly against the pad.
Squeeze your biceps at the peak of contraction just before your forearm reaches vertical.
Lower the dumbbell under control, uncurling your arm until you reach a full extension without hyperextending the elbow.
Complete all repetitions on one side before switching to the opposite arm.
instructions.breathing: Exhale as you curl the weight upward and inhale as you lower it under control.
cues: Keep the armpit pinned to the top of the pad.
Do not let the upper arm lift off the bench.
Control the descent; do not bounce out of the bottom.

common_faults.fault: Lifting the elbow off the pad during the curl.
common_faults.correction: Keep your upper arm firmly pressed against the bench pad throughout the entire set to isolate the elbow flexors.

common_faults.fault: Hyperextending or dropping into the bottom lockout with excessive speed.
common_faults.correction: Lower the dumbbell under strict control and decelerate gently into full extension to protect the biceps tendon.

precautions: Avoid aggressive bouncing or hyperextension at full extension to minimize strain on the distal biceps tendon.
